raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Adds three raw log-prob metrics next to the existing `training/rollout_probs_diff_*`:

- `training/rollout_logprobs_mismatch_count`: valid response tokens whose `rollout_log_probs != old_log_probs`
- `training/rollout_logprobs_diff_max` / `_mean`: |Δ| of the raw log-probs

`rollout_probs_diff_*` compares `exp(log_prob)` and cannot see a 1-ULP log-prob difference (float32 `-0.10000000149` vs `-0.10000000894` give the same prob). Exact 0-diff train-rollout work (verl-project/verl#7688, verl-project/verl-omni#637) needs a gate that only passes at zero elements, so the count is exposed directly. In the V1 trainer the count is aggregated by sum, not mean.

Emitted from `calculate_debug_metrics`, so every existing caller (v1 trainer, legacy trainer, separation trainer) gets it under `rollout.calculate_log_probs=True` with no config change.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Similar PRs: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+rollout_probs_diff — #6033 renames a helper, #4252 changes the pearson input; neither exposes raw log-prob metrics. #7196 (closed) was a bypass-mode diagnostic.
- [x] Title format `[training_utils, trainer, tests] feat: ...`

### Test

```bash
pytest tests/utils/debug/test_metrics.py tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_metrics_aggregator_on_cpu.py -q
# 23 passed
```

New cases: 1-ULP float32 pair where `rollout_probs_diff_max == 0` but `mismatch_count == 1`; all-masked batch returns `valid=0, mismatch_count=0`; aggregator sums the count across iterations.

### API and Usage Example

No API change. Three new keys in the metrics dict when `actor_rollout_ref.rollout.calculate_log_probs=True`.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/utils/debug/metrics.py`: compute the raw comparison alongside the prob-based one; default keys on an all-masked batch.
- `verl/trainer/ppo/v1/utils.py`: `rollout_logprobs_mismatch_count` uses the `sum` aggregation rule.
- tests as above.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the Contribute Guide.
- [x] `pre-commit run --files <changed files>`: ruff, ruff format, mypy, license, docstring, structure checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation: docstring only; no docs page lists per-metric keys for this file.
- [x] Unit tests added (CPU).

AI assistance was used for this change. I reviewed every line and ran the tests.

nodes.body:
Useful gate for exact 0-diff train-rollout work: `rollout_probs_diff_*` really can hide 1-ULP log-prob differences, and summing `mismatch_count` in the V1 aggregator is the right aggregation for a zero-element check.

One correctness nits on the inline comment: keep the mismatch count on the same `.float()` path as `rollout_logprobs_diff`, otherwise mixed bf16/fp32 batches can disagree between the count and the abs-diff metrics.

Also:
- `test_all_masked_returns_invalid` only checks `mismatch_count == 0`; please also assert the new `*_diff_max` / `*_diff_mean` stay `nan` on the early-return path.
- The checklist says no docs page lists these keys, but `docs/ascend_tutorial/zh/dev_guide/model_dev/parameter_and_metrics.md` already documents `training/rollout_probs_diff_*` — worth adding the three new keys there (or correcting the checklist).

`!=` compares the native dtypes, while `rollout_logprobs_diff` above casts both sides with `.float()` first. If `old_log_probs` / `rollout_log_probs` ever differ in dtype (bf16 vs fp32 is common), the mismatch count and the abs-diff metrics can disagree. Prefer deriving the count from the already-casted tensor, e.g. `int((rollout_logprobs_diff != 0).sum().item())`, so both metrics share one comparison path.

+def test_rollout_logprobs_mismatch_count_sums():
+    # a token count: the gate needs the total over the aggregation window, not the mean per iteration.
+    agg = MetricsAggregator()
+    agg.add_step_metrics({"training/rollout_logprobs_mismatch_count": 0})
+    agg.add_step_metrics({"training/rollout_logprobs_mismatch_count": 3})
+    assert agg.get_aggregated_metrics()["training/rollout_logprobs_mismatch_count"] == 3
+

 def test_global_seqlen_minmax_diff_is_recomputed_from_aggregated_min_max():

     # "max" substring heuristic over the per-iteration diffs.

@@ -42,6 +42,39 @@ def test_calculate_debug_metrics(self):
         metrics = calculate_debug_metrics(data)
         print(metrics)
         assert metrics["training/rollout_probs_diff_valid"] == 1
+        assert metrics["training/rollout_logprobs_mismatch_count"] == 20
+        assert metrics["training/rollout_logprobs_diff_max"] > 0
+
+    def test_one_ulp_logprob_difference_is_hidden_by_probs_diff(self):
+        rollout = torch.tensor([[-0.10000000149, -2.0, -0.5]], dtype=torch.float32)
+        actor = torch.tensor([[-0.10000000894, -2.0, -0.75]], dtype=torch.float32)
+        assert torch.exp(rollout[0, 0]) == torch.exp(actor[0, 0])
+        data = DataProto.from_dict(
+            {
+                "rollout_log_probs": rollout,
+                "old_log_probs": actor,
+                "response_mask": torch.tensor([[1, 1, 0]]),
+                "responses": torch.zeros((1, 3)),
+            }
+        )
+        metrics = calculate_debug_metrics(data)
+        assert metrics["training/rollout_probs_diff_max"] == 0
+        assert metrics["training/rollout_logprobs_mismatch_count"] == 1
+        assert metrics["training/rollout_logprobs_diff_max"] == (rollout[0, 0] - actor[0, 0]).abs().item()
+        assert metrics["training/rollout_logprobs_diff_mean"] == metrics["training/rollout_logprobs_diff_max"] / 2
+
+    def test_all_masked_returns_invalid(self):
+        data = DataProto.from_dict(
+            {
+                "rollout_log_probs": torch.tensor([[-1.0, -2.0]]),
+                "old_log_probs": torch.tensor([[-1.5, -2.0]]),
+                "response_mask": torch.tensor([[0, 0]]),
+                "responses": torch.zeros((1, 2)),
+            }
+        )
+        metrics = calculate_debug_metrics(data)
+        assert metrics["training/rollout_probs_diff_valid"] == 0
+        assert metrics["training/rollout_logprobs_mismatch_count"] == 0
